# Lemon Tracking

> Lemon Tracking is a local screen and application activity tracker.

Homepage: https://lemontracking.org/
Downloads: https://lemontracking.org/download/
Documentation: https://lemontracking.org/docs/
FAQ: https://lemontracking.org/faq/
Legal: https://lemontracking.org/legal/

The 0.1.0 release contains a Windows x64 collector. Activity records stay on the device running the collector. The public source repository is not published yet.
